description: This pie chart visually represents the distribution of three distinct levels—Level1, Level2, and Level3—within a hierarchical catalogue, with each segment corresponding to a specific value and percentage. The chart is divided into three slices: the largest segment, colored medium blue, is labeled “Level2 - 12.1” and accounts for 44.32% of the total; the second largest, in a lighter blue, is labeled “Level1 - 8.2” and represents 30.04%; the third segment, in a darker blue, is labeled “Level3 - 7.0” and shows 25.64%, though this percentage is displayed with a semi-transparent gray overlay. The chart lacks a legend and does not explode or emphasize any particular slice; instead, the segments are arranged in descending order of size, with Level2 occupying the largest portion, followed by Level1, then Level3. Each slice is clearly labeled with its category name and associated numerical value outside the pie, while percentage values are inscribed within the respective slices.
